meaning: Actual explicit-path/candidate/glob/watcher-prefix functions and absolutePath helper over private regular files, directories and symlinks. A minimal ConfigManager supplies only main path and tracked-path storage. A status adapter records queries and forwards to the original filesystem status implementation. Actual Lua 5.4 package.searchpath is queried directly through its C API with private candidate paths; no config Lua is executed. No package cache/custom-searcher, file-race, authorization, watcher-delivery or compositor certificate.
